# Audio fixtures

These files are generated by `scripts/make-fixtures.sh` (requires ffmpeg) and are released
under the project's license (MIT OR Apache-2.0). Regenerate them by running the script.

Generated with ffmpeg 9.0.2 (gyan.dev full build). The script passes `-bitexact`, so reruns are
byte-identical except `tone.ogg` and `tone.opus`, whose Ogg stream serial numbers are random;
those files decode to the same audio either way.

The total size stays under 500 KB. For WAV input without ffmpeg, the `test-support` feature of
`aria-audio` provides `aria_audio::testing`.
